title: Every flow's controls card on the Flows page is built the same way: padded card, one button size, a segmented dial, matching inputs
description: The Owner's screenshot of /flows/<key> Controls (2026-11-11) showed three flow cards built three ways: the first padded, the others with text running to a stray left bar (the state edge drew on an unpadded fieldset inside a padded list item), a dial that was a tall tray with the chosen stop detached from the rest, Turn off as a bare link next to a raised Run now, an unstyled time picker beside a styled select, and Save buttons in different places. The card becomes the fieldset itself (one box for padding, state edge and live sweep); Turn on/off and Run now share one size; the dial is the design system's segmented control with the chosen stop's hint below; the time input joins the shared input style; the morning run and daily reach sit in one tidy section; and the sender explanation shows once for the list. Existing labels the other flow probes rely on are unchanged.
acceptance: base.css styles input[type="time"] with the shared input rule
The card box (.flow-card) carries the padding; the list items around it carry none
Every flow group is a fieldset with class flow-card
Turn on/off and Run now are both btn-small and neither is btn-quiet
The dial is a .segmented radiogroup with radios named Draft, Copilot, Autopilot and one hint for the chosen stop
The sender setup link shows once for the list
